page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, built on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 12 dedicated vCPUs derived from 6 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance type, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the instance exhibits average multi-core performance but struggles with single-threaded workloads. Single-core metrics, such as the Geekbench single-core score and stress-ng single-core CPU performance, fall into the bottom 10% to 25% tier. Conversely, multi-threaded operations, including Geekbench multi-core and Passmark CPU tests, achieve average mid-tier results. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle 50% range for both cached and uncached operations, though the overall Passmark memory score is relatively weak.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge represents a legacy architecture that offers a cost-effective option for workloads requiring dedicated vCPUs and moderate memory capacity without needing high-end single-core speed. It is well-suited for multi-threaded general-purpose applications, moderate database operations, Redis caching, and basic web serving. However, it is less optimal for single-threaded tasks, high-throughput static web serving, or intensive LLM inference.
